from.place: proof, finite pseudo-coherence makes derived internal Hom preserve bounded-below quasi-coherent complexes

title: Finite pushforward algebra gives quasi-coherent derived Hom
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then the sheaf algebra $f_*\mathcal O_X$ is pseudo-coherent over $\mathcal O_Y$, and the derived internal Hom $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], viewed as a complex of $f_*\mathcal O_X$-modules, belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]; in particular its image in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.
